summary: Iteration 5 full-stack test of DBG Signs CRM. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py (34 tests) + regression suites backend_test.py & test_iteration4.py => 79/79 pytest tests PASS (run serially with -n 0 because the iteration-5 suite shares module state). Verified: tier discounts (T1 35% / T2 25% / T3 15% / none 0%) with exact math (subtotal 266.66 -> discount 93.33 -> tax 17.33 -> total 190.66), discount carry-through EST->SO->INV, direct invoice discount, commission still computed on the PRE-discount subtotal (266.66 x 10% = 26.67), new customer fields (title/tier/net_terms/portal_enabled) persisted via POST/PUT and no _id leakage, portal gating (self-registered customer 200 then 403 'Portal access is not enabled' after admin disables), PUT /api/settings now persists shop_sqft_per_hr & machine_sqft_per_hr (prior HIGH FIXED) plus throughput costing regression (labor 43.33 / machine 23.33), GET /api/receivables/overdue?days=45 (days_overdue correct, paid excluded, days param respected), POST /api/invoices/{id}/send-past-due (real Resend 202 to delivered@resend.dev, email_token stored, read receipt flips sent->opened via /api/track/open/{token}), no-email customer graceful skip, staff PDFs for invoice/estimate/sales-order (application/pdf, %PDF magic, 404 on bad id, 401 unauth) and public tokenized /api/pub/pdf/{token} (200 inline PDF without auth, 404 on bad token), /api/search (invoice#, customer, material, line-item description, empty q, no-match, regex-injection safe, salesman allowed, unauth blocked), RBAC (salesman 403 on both send-past-due endpoints, settings PUT, materials POST, bills, users; still 200 on overdue read + PDF), Xero CSV negative 'Tier discount' row. Frontend: Customers table Tier/Terms/Portal columns + T1-35% badge, dialog cust-title/cust-tier/cust-terms(COD,50/50,Net 10,Net 15)/cust-portal all persist on re-open; DocBuilder live 'Tier 1 discount (35%)' -$93.33 row; Settings 200/250 save + reload persistence PASS then reset to 150/150; sidebar global search (invoice #, customer, material, line-item desc, 'No matches') and result click navigation; Invoices + Receivables PDF download buttons produce INV-XXXX.pdf; Receivables 'Send Past-Due (1)' header button (bulk toast 'Sent 1, skipped 0'), per-row pastdue button shown ONLY for the >45d row, invoice email badge flips to 'Read'; salesman can search + download PDFs and has no Receivables nav / no past-due controls. One MEDIUM-HIGH frontend bug found: the customer Portal has no error handling for the new 403 portal gate.

minor.issue: Still a 1-cent rounding mismatch carried from iteration 4: DocBuilder shows subtotal $266.67 / tax $17.33 / total $190.67 while the backend saves 266.66 / 17.33 / 190.66 (backend rounds hours to 4dp before multiplying by the rate). Discount row itself matches (-$93.33).
Salesman receives 'payable': 1240.5 and the dashboard renders an Accounts Payable card, even though GET /api/bills is 403 for salesman. AP totals arguably should be admin-only.

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM-HIGH: api.get('/portal/orders') has no .catch. When a customer's portal_enabled=false the backend correctly returns 403 with detail 'Portal access is not enabled for your account. Please contact DBG Signs.', but the promise rejection is unhandled: CRA shows an 'Uncaught runtime errors: Request failed with status code 403' overlay in preview and in production the customer just sees an empty 'Welcome / My Orders' page with 0 orders and NO explanation. Add an error state that renders the backend detail message.
ui_bugs.selector: route /portal (no error element rendered; console: 'Failed to load resource: 403')

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM: 'Record Bill' and 'Add Material' quick-action buttons render for the salesman role (whose nav hides Payables/Materials and whose API writes are 403). Clicking 'Record Bill' does nothing at all (stays on /dashboard) - dead buttons. Hide admin-only quick actions for salesman.
ui_bugs.selector: Dashboard quick action buttons (no data-testid on quick actions)

issues: No contrast, spacing or overflow problems observed; Tier badge (T1 - 35%) and Portal 'On/Off' markers are legible; search dropdown overlays the sidebar cleanly and closes on outside click
Discount row is green (#16A34A) and clearly labelled 'Tier 1 discount (35%)'; totals block aligned, no overflow (iteration-4 fix holds)
Console warning repeated on every DialogContent: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' - accessibility nit, add DialogDescription or aria-describedby

action_items: MEDIUM-HIGH: Portal.jsx - add .catch on the /portal/orders load and render the 403 detail ('Portal access is not enabled...') as an error state instead of an empty dashboard / unhandled rejection.
MEDIUM: Hide 'Record Bill' and 'Add Material' dashboard quick actions from the salesman role (currently visible and non-functional), and give quick actions data-testids.
LOW: Align FE/BE rounding (round currency, not hours) so DocBuilder preview totals match the saved document to the cent.
LOW: Consider gating the dashboard 'payable' figure to admins.
LOW: Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to dialogs to clear the repeated a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Every page that loads data via api.get should have a rejection handler with a visible error state - Portal.jsx is the only remaining unguarded loader and it is exactly the surface the new 403 gate hits.

customer_discount() re-reads the customer on every create/update; fine at this scale, but consider returning the whole customer so net_terms can be stamped onto the doc at creation time (PDF currently resolves terms from the live customer, so changing a customer's terms retroactively changes historical PDFs).

_days_overdue() falls back to created_at when due_date is missing, so an old invoice with no due date can appear in the >45d past-due list and receive a dunning email - consider requiring due_date for dunning.
/api/search runs 5 sequential regex queries per keystroke (debounced 250ms) with no text index; add indexes on number/name/company/line_items.description before the data set grows.
server.py is 1436 lines - split into routers (documents, receivables, pdf, email, search) per the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all iteration-5 flows pass; portal 403 error state missing, salesman dashboard dead quick-action buttons)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: TEST_ tier customers (1/2/3/none, delivered@resend.dev), TEST_UI Tier Customer (T1/Net 10/portal on), TEST_UI Discount Job estimate, TEST_UI PastDue Job invoice INV-0014 (due date backdated 60 days), self-registered portal users test_portal_*/test_ui_portal@example.com. All removed; db.users back to the 4 real accounts, customers back to Dan Reed / Maria Lopez / DBG Test, settings restored to 65/150/35/150/40 (verified via GET). NOTE: the TEST_-prefix cleanup also removed two leftover estimates from earlier iterations (EST-0001 orphan + EST-0002); remaining demo data is EST-0068, SO-0001/0010/0011, INV-0002, 3 customers, 3 materials - re-seed the demo EST->SO->INV chain if the UI needs richer sample data.
test_credentials: Admin sales@dbgsigns.com/10297099, Salesman sam@dbgsigns.com/Sales2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Login returns httpOnly cookies (no token in body) - use a requests.Session, not Bearer headers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend suites SERIALLY: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -n 0 -q` (test_iteration5.py shares a module-level STATE dict across classes, so xdist loadscope would break it). 79 tests currently pass. Email: /api/auth/login sets httpOnly cookies, so requests.Session works without headers. Each full run of test_iteration5.py consumes exactly 1 real Resend send (delivered@resend.dev) in TestPastDue::test_send_past_due_email_and_read_receipt; on upstream quota the endpoint now returns HTTP 429 with JSON detail and the test self-skips. Playwright gotchas hit this round: (1) window.confirm - use `await page.evaluate("window.confirm = () => true")`; a sync `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` never resolves in async Playwright and hangs the click for 30s; (2) do not reload within ~2s of a save click or the in-flight PUT is aborted (this produced a false 'settings did not persist' the first time - Settings persistence genuinely PASSES); (3) salesman has no Receivables nav item, so past-due UI checks must use the admin. To create a past-due row: POST /api/invoices with due_date 60 days back, then delete it after.
rca_of_the_issue: Portal 403 blank screen: Portal.jsx's load() is `api.get('/portal/orders').then(setData)` with no rejection handler, so the new portal_enabled gate (server.py portal_orders -> HTTPException 403) produces an unhandled axios rejection; React keeps the initial empty state and renders 'Welcome / 0 orders', hiding the backend's explanatory detail. Fix = try/catch (or .catch) storing e.response?.data?.detail and rendering an error panel. Prior iteration-4 HIGH (settings throughput) is genuinely fixed: Settings.jsx now PUTs all 5 fields (verified payload {shop_rate_per_hr:65,shop_sqft_per_hr:150,machine_rate_per_hr:35,machine_sqft_per_hr:150,default_markup:40}) and 200/250 survived a full reload.
